assignment_algorithm.name: deterministic_hamilton_quota_largest_block_first
assignment_algorithm.apportionment: Hamilton largest remainder on atomic-unit counts; ties SOURCE_VALID,SOURCE_TEST,REF_TRAIN
assignment_algorithm.order_units: descending number of populations, descending sample count, ascending sha256 of sorted private member IDs
assignment_algorithm.balance_objective: within exact unit quotas, greedily minimize normalized population fill, then normalized sample fill, then fixed role order

gates.F0: The M27E manifest authenticates all 22 IBD files, 22 maps and the frozen strata; identities and counts match.
gates.F1: All 128 NatWGS samples and their complete canonical-population/primary-IBD closure are quarantined in DISCOVERY.
gates.F2: No individual, canonical population or primary IBD block crosses roles, and no mixed-ancestry atomic unit is assigned.
gates.F3: AFR, EUR and NAM each retain at least two atomic units and two populations in each source role.
gates.F4: No VCF, genotype, rare-support, position, baseline-overlap or LAI result is an input to the split.
gates.F5: Per ancestry, assigned atomic-unit counts exactly equal the preregistered 50/25/25 Hamilton quotas.
gates.F6: Assignment is invariant to input order; public outputs contain no sample IDs or population labels.

next_gate: None with the current assets: preserve the canonical 50/25/25 split for auditability, but do not open a new REF/VALID evaluation because the original holdout was used by a later exploratory split. Reopening requires an independent external panel and a new preregistration.
